title: Puzzle hints
idea: Puzzle hints: Current constraint and optional graduated hints preserve agency
audience: People who need to solve puzzle within a game surface.
avoidWhen: Hints reveal the entire solution immediately
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic decision layout through its solve puzzle priority and explicit commitment contract: Using a hint states any scoring consequence before commitment
navigation: Puzzle hints keeps the current solve puzzle context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Current constraint and optional graduated hints preserve agency
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to solve puzzle; players benefit from progressive assistance
composition.priority: Using a hint states any scoring consequence before commitment

imagery.role: Support the actual solve puzzle context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep puzzle state visible while a hint panel opens
Compose for safe zones, aspect ratio and the actual input device; preserve world readability.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the puzzle hints structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no solve puzzle content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Using a hint states any scoring consequence before commitment
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized solve puzzle content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Using a hint states any scoring consequence before commitment
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active solve puzzle context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure frame-time and input latency in the real engine; DOM checks cannot certify in-world UI.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
